jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.occupation: Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr CRA) / Senior Klinischer Monitor – Full-Time or Part-Time... (Referent/in - klinische Studien (CRA))
jobs.description:
Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr CRA) / Senior Klinischer Monitor – Full-Time or Part-Time Available (m/w/d)

Job available in 12 locations: Remote, Ulm, Frankfurt, Berlin, Leipzig, Düsseldorf, Bremen, Aachen, Stuttgart, Bonn, Munich, Hamburg

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions
Office

Job Description

About Us

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Our global Clinical Operations teams provide end-to-end clinical trial support — from study start-up through close-out — across commercial and government-sponsored studies.

Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific / PPD?

- Work on high-quality, global clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas
- Be part of a stable, well-established organization with long-term career opportunities
- Strong collaboration with experienced CTMs and project teams
- Clear development pathways (e.g., Senior CRA, Lead CRA, CTM)
- Flexible working models that support work-life balance
- Permanent employment
- Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (32 hours/week) options available

About the Role

This position is for experienced Clinical Research Associates with 2+ years of independent monitoring experience. You will manage clinical trial sites across Germany, ensuring studies are conducted in compliance with the protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable regulations, and company SOPs.

You’ll work autonomously, partner closely with investigative sites, and collaborate with project teams to deliver high-quality, inspection-ready clinical trials.

What You’ll Do

- Perform site monitoring activities (on-site and remote) using a risk-based monitoring approach
- Ensure protocol, ICH-GCP, regulatory, and SOP compliance at investigator sites
- Conduct SDR, SDV, CRF review, and investigational product accountability
- Identify, document, escalate, and follow up on issues through resolution, applying root cause analysis and CAPA principles
- Maintain audit and inspection readiness at all assigned sites
- Build strong, collaborative relationships with investigators and site staff
- Document monitoring activities in timely, high-quality reports and follow-up letters
- Maintain ongoing communication with sites between visits to support issue resolution and data quality
- Ensure study systems (e.g., CTMS) are updated according to study conventions
- Provide trial status updates and metrics to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM)
- Support study start-up, investigator identification, site initiation, and study close-out activities as assigned
- Participate in investigator meetings, audits, inspections, and project team meetings as required

Additional responsibilities may include supporting process improvement initiatives, mentoring activities, or project-specific tasks aligned with experience.

A Day in the Life

- Review site metrics and prioritize monitoring activities based on risk
- Conduct on-site or remote monitoring visits
- Partner with sites to resolve findings and improve processes
- Collaborate with CTMs and project teams to keep studies on track and inspection-ready
- Complete documentation, system updates, and administrative tasks

Education & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent qualification
- Minimum 2+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate / Monitor
- Valid driver’s license
- Full right to work in Germany
- Fluency in German and English (C1 level) – interviews will be conducted in German

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong clinical monitoring skills with hands-on RBM experience
- Excellent understanding and application of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations
- Solid therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Well-developed critical thinking, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with medical professionals
- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to cross-functional teams
- Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic project environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn clinical systems (e.g., CTMS)

Locations: Home-based or hybrid anywhere in Germany
FTE: Full-time (40 hrs/week) or Part-time 80% (32 hrs/week)
Contract: Permanent
Travel: Approximately 50–75% (study-dependent)

Severely disabled applicants with the same aptitude will be given preferential treatment. Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Purpose of your Job

Are you looking for a career in research & development of biopharmaceuticals or in general in the pharmaceutical industry?
Then join Coriolis Pharma and contribute with state-of-the-art capillary electrophoresis analytics to our formulations and lyophilization processes for biopharmaceutical drugs!
You will join a highly motivated, interdisciplinary team performing contract research and development for customers in the (bio) pharmaceutical industry worldwide.
You will be a vital part of our contract research organization – where you will support & learn from our scientific operations teams – to enable our clients in their journey of developing innovative drugs.

Your Responsibility

As Senior Scientist you are - together with the project team - responsible for the successful development and execution of capillary electrophoresis (CE) analysis for our customers worldwide.  

- Responsible—as subject matter expert—for supporting client project acquisition and execution with expertise to ensure high-quality services.
- Accountable for the electrophoretic characterization of biopharmaceutical molecules (proteins, peptides, nucleic acids) within client projects, including the de novo development of CE methods and the interpretation of data in context with other analytical approaches (such as LC-MS or LC-IEX).
- Maintain cutting-edge scientific knowledge in CE and related areas and drive CE innovation to meet evolving business needs, including new business areas and novel molecular modalities.
- Work cooperatively across Coriolis teams (e.g., business development, finance, technical support team) to ensure seamless collaboration with all operational groups during client project execution.
- Function as project leader for assigned client projects, overseeing project planning, method implementation, development, characterization, data evaluation, and reporting activities.

What you need to succeed

- University degree in analytical chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, (bio)chemistry, or a related field; a PhD related to separation sciences—ideally focused on CE applications / method development and associated areas—is preferred
- Minimum 5 years of industry experience (with PhD in a relevant field) or 9 years (without PhD) with in-depth knowledge of biopharmaceutical characterization by CE (CE-SDS, CZE, cIEF) using UV, PDA, LIF, or FLD detection
- Several years of hands-on experience with CE instruments from different vendors (e.g., Sciex, BioTechne/ProteinSimple, Agilent, etc.)
- Proven experience in developing, transferring, and troubleshooting CE (and associated) analytical methods in an industry setting, including both R&D and GMP environments
- Demonstrated project management skills, including resource management, multitasking, prioritization, and risk management
- Strong lateral leadership capabilities, with leading by example as a natural approach
- Hands-on, proactive mindset with openness to new ideas and tasks; a can-do attitude is essential
- Team-oriented personality with strong motivational and interpersonal skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

jobs.occupation: Flight Test Ground Station Systems Architect (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the Flight Test Ground Station Germany Team Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Flight Test Ground Station Systems Architect (m/w/d)

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

** Our Benefits for You**

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

** Your tasks and responsibilities**

As a Systems & Software Architect for the Flight Test Ground Station (FTGS)

- you will lead the end-to-end architectural lifecycle for a complex suite of flight test tools, including FTGS-Core, FIDA, and various Add-On tools.
- you will be responsible for defining and documenting comprehensive system requirements, balancing operational needs, technical constraints, and stringent regulatory requirements.
- your core mission involves developing and iterating robust architectures encompassing hardware, software, and network infrastructure.
- Utilizing established architectural patterns and best practices, you will design modular, scalable systems and produce high-quality design specifications, interface definitions, and technical documentation.
- You will play a decisive role in evaluating and selecting the technologies and components necessary for successful system implementation, ensuring seamless interoperability and compatibility between various subsystems and external interfaces.
- Beyond design, you will drive technical excellence by establishing development best practices, conducting detailed design studies, and overseeing validation and verification (V&V) strategies. You will actively support the system integration process and contribute to the creation of test strategies to validate architecture and performance.
- A key aspect of this role is cross-functional leadership within an Integrated Product Team (IPT). You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams—including software, hardware, test, and operations engineers—to resolve complex technical challenges.
- By leading "tiger teams" to address critical issues and facilitating continuous improvement through rigorous retrospectives, you will ensure long-term technical consistency.
- Furthermore, you will remain at the forefront of the industry by monitoring emerging technologies and trends in flight test and ground station systems, ensuring the FTGS toolchain remains cutting-edge and future-proof.

** Desired skills and qualifications**

- Education: Completed university degree (Master’s or Diploma) in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science
- Professional Experience: Several years of professional experience in system architecture or the design of complex technical systems, ideally within the Aerospace or Defense sectors.
- Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of Flight Test Ground Station systems, telemetry, data processing, and data analysis.
- Technical Proficiency:
- Advanced expertise in C++ development and software design patterns.
- Strong command of Linux environments and system administration.
- Proven experience with various software/hardware architectures and network protocols.
- Expertise in defining system requirements and creating architectural models (e.g., UML, SysML).
- Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop innovative, scalable solutions.
- Soft Skills: Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to thrive in a multidisciplinary, international environment.
- Languages: Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
- Travel: Willingness to undertake occasional business travel.
- Preferred: Practical experience in flight test analysis is advantageous.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Job description

In order to provide high-fidelity training simulation, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Radar Simulation Specialist (d/f/m)

You will join a team of experienced engineers and subject matter experts to jointly define, implement and integrate complex simulation sub-systems in the domain of sensors and weapons. Our engineers are closely collaborating with other departments and external suppliers in order to provide solutions for high-fidelity trainings systems, with current focus on the Eurofighter pilot training simulation system PSTS.

You will serve as Technical Lead to ensure the provision of tailored simulation solutions for various radar systems, ranging from versatile, generic model to high-fidelity replicas of actual systems, such as the current Eurofighter MSCAN Radar, as well as future systems such as the Eurofighter ESCAN Radar. Based on your deep technical understanding of actual systems and your knowledge of electronic warfare, you will play a key role in the definition and development of optimal solutions to match simulation and/or training needs while respecting technical limitations of distributed real-time systems. As such, you are closely cooperating with various engineering teams, Chief Engineering and Operational Factors, and will act for Radar-related topics as point of contract for alignments and discussions with the Customer and external suppliers.

Major Role & Responsibilities

- Technical Lead to ensure the provision of tailored Radar simulation solutions
- Ensuring the technical expertise regarding current and future radar systems, such as Eurofighter MSCAN and ESCAN Radar
- Performance of Systems Engineering activities to ensure the viable technical radar solutions meeting the requirements and needs of the overall system.
- Technical coordination of external suppliers an alignment with internal stakeholders, such as Chief Engineering, development teams and Operational Factors
- Support of the integration and testing activities at the simulation devices in close collaboration of other subject matter experts
- Ensuring on-time, cost- and quality-compliant development as well as integration of a consistent and powerful radar simulation across all project phases.
- Technical support in the assessment and selection of suppliers

Specific & Technical Skills / Experience Required

- Expertise regarding - Eurofighter MSCAN Radar
- Eurofighter Training Needs and the current Pilot Synthetic Traning System (PSTS)
- Systems engineering (incl. tools such as DOORS)
- V-model based SW development process
- Extensive Experience in - Eurofighter MSCAN Radar integration and/or flight test
- Eurofighter Training Simulations Solutions (ASTA/PSTS)
- Eurofighter MSCAN Radar integration and/or flight test
- Systems Engineering and V-model based SW development process, including active contribution in integration activities
- IT literate (MS Office applications)

General Skills / Experience Required

- Educated to degree level in computer science or engineering
- Good language skills in English, both written and spoken
- Strong communication skills with an ability to operate in a multi-cultural environment
- Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy while maintaining close, effective collaboration within a multi-disciplinary team.
- Capability to respond to changes in activities and priorities
- Experience in the alignment with and coordination of various stakeholders

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
We are seeking an accomplished Scientist to advance our mission of delivering disease-modifying therapies to patients with liver cirrhosis.
As Principal Scientist, you will lead a team of lab scientists and take ownership of identifying and advancing novel therapeutic approaches — from target identification through to candidate selection. A deep understanding of liver physiology and expert knowledge of disease-relevant cellular and tissue models will set you up for success in this role.
Join us and drive innovative drug discovery projects within our Cardio-Renal-Metabolic Diseases Research Department, located at Boehringer Ingelheim's largest R&D site in Biberach an der Riss, Germany. You will work alongside talented colleagues, access cutting-edge technology, and help shape the future of liver disease therapy
Tasks & responsibilities

- Manage an in vitro pharmacology lab and mentor a team of highly skilled lab scientists, fostering a collaborative environment and actively developing the skills of your team members.
- Apply innovative in vitro and ex vivo models that reflect human liver disease conditions to identify promising drug candidates.
- Build the evidence base to translate therapeutic concepts from preclinical models to patients, leveraging experimental models and data science tools.
- Navigate effectively within a matrix-based environment, collaborating across disciplines including Medicinal Chemistry, Biologics Development, Drug Discovery Support functions, Computational Innovation, and Experimental Medicine.
- Enable decision making by communicating complex results efficiently to stakeholders.
- Maintain a strong external network, manage external collaborations, and contribute to advancing the science of liver cirrhosis by publishing papers and presenting at scientific conferences

Requirements

- Doctorate (PhD) in biology, biochemistry, or molecular pharmacology, with expert knowledge in liver physiology specifically the pathophysiology of cirrhosis complications. Knowledge of alcohol-associated liver cirrhosis is a plus.
- Multiple years of drug discovery experience in a pharmaceutical industry setting, with demonstrated expertise spanning target identification through to candidate selection. Proficiency in cell-based methods (primary cells, organotypic cultures) to model liver disease conditions in vitro/ex vivo. Skilled in molecular, cellular and biochemical profiling techniques.
- Proven line-management and leadership skills, including setting and evaluating objectives and advancing the development of team members.
- Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary project team.
- Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills, combined with agile working, innovative thinking, and a problem-solving mindset.
Fluent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is a plus.
Start date: ASAP
As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

jobs.description:
Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools, outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial, construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement, repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® ̶ recognized worldwide for their deep heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality.

The company maintains a global manufacturing and product development footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2 billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth.

As part of a structured succession planning process at our Winnenden (Stuttgart area) site, we are looking for a

Controller (m/f/d) European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance

who is motivated to take on increasing responsibility and further develop their career within an international environment.

In this role, you will work closely with the current Team Lead and gain comprehensive insight into the financial steering of our European logistics organization. Over time, you will be systematically introduced to broader responsibilities and leadership-related tasks. This position offers a clear perspective to assume the Team Lead role for European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance in the future as part of our long-term succession planning.

Your responsibilities:

- Logistics cost controlling: partner closely with the logistics organization to perform budget-to-actual analyses, ad hoc evaluations, scenario analyses, and management reporting
- Budgeting & forecasting: prepare annual budgets, periodic forecasts, and financial outlooks
- Closing activities: support month-end and year-end closing processes
- Management reporting: prepare, analyze, and continuously improve monthly management reports and KPIs
- Support the strategic planning of European logistics operations and develop business cases for the development of the European warehouse footprint
- Inventory controlling: analyze inventory levels, inventory variances, rework and scrapping activities to track financial impacts and identify risks and opportunities
- Projects & process improvements: participate in international and cross-functional projects with a focus on enhancing controlling processes, reporting standards, and digital tools
- Leadership exposure: collaborate closely with the current Team Lead, gaining insight into leadership responsibilities, stakeholder management, and strategic decision-making processes

Your profile:

- Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable qualification
- Relevant experience in Controlling, Finance, or a related analytical business partnering role, ideally in an international environment
- Business analytical skills, interest in numbers and data, and the expertise to translate financial insights into business recommendations
- Competent knowledge of Excel and BI tools; SAP knowledge as a plus
- Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented working style combined with collaboration skills
- Communication and stakeholder management skills across different organizational levels
- Interest in taking on additional responsibility and developing toward a leadership position
- Good command of German and English
- Willingness to travel according to business need within Europe

What we offer:

- An interesting position with an attractive company––recognized as a “top employer” by kununu
- A genuine succession opportunity: This position has been created as part of a long-term succession plan. You will work closely with the current Team Lead and be systematically prepared for broader responsibilities and a potential future leadership role.
- A challenging and impactful role within an international organization and a highly motivated team
- The opportunity to actively shape and further develop our European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance Controlling organization
- Flexible working hours, hybrid working options, and 30 days of annual leave
- Capital-forming benefits and company pension scheme
- EGYM Wellpass corporate fitness membership
- Employee discounts, JobRad bicycle leasing, complimentary fruit, water and coffee, and additional attractive benefits

Are you interested?

Then send your application stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations to jobs@tti-emea.com or apply directly via our careers page. Naturally, we will treat your application with the utmost discretion.
